steps.title: Position and Prepare Mouse
steps.instruction: Place the mouse in a ventral position and wet the hair by spraying the cranium with 70% EtOH.

steps.title: Remove Head from Body
steps.instruction: If removal of the head from the body is desired, cut transversely immediately caudal to the occiput using a sharp pair of large scissors and discard the body appropriately.

steps.title: Expose the Skull
steps.instruction: Incise the cutaneous layers using small scissors in a midline sagittal cut extending from the caudal occiput to the rostrum, then displace the skin tissue laterally to visualize the skull.

steps.title: Perform Orbital Incision
steps.instruction: Place the tips of the small scissors in the orbitals and cut the skull transversely.

steps.title: Perform Midline Skull Cut
steps.instruction: Fix the tips of the small scissors under the occiput of the skull and, using slow rostral progression and small precise movements, cut on the midline to the previous orbit incision.

steps.title: Remove Left Skull Hemisphere
steps.instruction: Peel the skull from the brain by placing forceps under the skull at the left-side incision, gripping, and pulling laterally perpendicular to the midline.

substeps.instruction: If the skull breaks into pieces, remove each piece individually until complete hemisphere exposure is achieved.

steps.title: Remove Right Skull Hemisphere
steps.instruction: Repeat the forceps gripping and lateral pulling process on the right hemisphere.

steps.title: Extract the Brain
steps.instruction: Excise the brain by placing forceps beneath the brainstem and gently pulling superiorly and rostrally.

substeps.instruction: Optionally invert the mouse so the dorsal surface of the cranium is closest to the workbench to allow gravity to assist in extraction.
